note: Illinois DNR park near Clayton. Four wooded loops (Hickory Hill, Oak Ridge, Pine Grove, Whispering Pines) spread over about 1.4 km above the lake, none within sight of the water; Hickory Hill is walk-up only. A few pads are only 20 ft (Oak Ridge 095, Pine Grove 046). Horses use a separate equestrian camp about 1 km away. The lake has fishing piers and boat rentals. --Claude
